newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina expands global bond issue to $1 billion.
newsitem.headline: Argentina expands global bond issue to $1 billion.

text.p: Argentina will expand its global bond issue to $1 billion from an originally-scheduled $750 million due to the "excellent response" of financial markets, the Economy Ministry said Tuesday.

"Even though the initial amount was for $750 million, the excellent response that this issue had in the international financial community brought us to increase the issue to $1 billion," the ministry said in a statement.
The 10-year bonds will be placed at between 445-450 basis points above the 10-year U.S. treasury note.
The pricing of the bond is set for Wednesday, the ministry said.
